brief: A community for Newhouse international students and alumni. Not only to help them succeed at Newhouse, but to help them experience it: the time we share, while we're here, and what we leave behind for the next class.
criteria: Success: one idea in one sentence, no globes, planes, flags or hands, readable at 16 px, black and white only.

concepts.name: Shared Stretch
concepts.idea: Two strokes make one N and run side by side through the middle: the time we share.
rationale: Two strokes, two people: one who was here first and one who has just arrived. Neither makes an N alone
Side by side through the middle, one gap apart, is the stretch of time they share
Turned half a circle it is the same shape: each class is handed what the last one held
One stroke width, one gap and one 30-degree slant, with a heavier cut for tabs and app icons

recommendation: Shared Stretch: two paths that make one N, side by side for the time we share.
next_steps: Share the kit with the team
The site header, footer and tab icon already use it, white on dark and black on light
Order a first run of stickers and tote bags
